games.name: MotionPlay Sports
games.summary: Finally, a realistic Superhero 3D Flying Game that is challenging enough for adults, easy to use for kids and even a toddler can keep busy with the continuous practice mode.  This family friendly action arcade and simulation game will give you the feeling of flight, with all the speed and maneuvering you would expect if you were a superhero.  With the accelerometer setting, you can hold out your arms and make the flying more virtual.  With the joystick setting, you more easily play on a table top.  You can speed up or slow down the flight and during the mission mode, you will be able to collect certain objects, while avoiding others that will drain your energy field.  Here is a summary of what you can expect from this game: Key Features:-Realistic 3D Flying Movements and Scenery Graphics-Choose Between Being a Boy or Girl Superhero.-Successfully Complete Each Mission And Earn A Bronze, Silver, Gold or Diamond Medal.-Finish All Four Missions And Become Either A Junior, Amateur, Professional or Master Superhero.-Use The Accelerometer Tilting Or On Screen Joystick Setting.-Use The Practice Mode To Explore All Around The City, Mountain, Rural or Space Levels As You Unlock Them.-Practice Mode Is A Continuous Loop , So You Can Fly For Hours and Younger Kids Won't Have To Restart It.-Enjoy the Great Star Kids Music Or Mute It.  The Game Story:Star Kids is the story of two super kids who came here to help save our planet and protect all the people of earth.  This includes neutralizing toxic bubbles in the atmosphere, retrieving vital medical supplies that fell off a supply truck on the way to the hospital, restoring communications to one of earth's government satellites, and even saving endangered eggs from a fire that is threatening their location. Their superhero powers include being able to fly, time traveling, energy protective field around their bodies and the ability to regenerate through harnessing star power ups after injury.  Each one of the four separate missions will award you a certain medal of excellence if you were able to complete them and if you have what it takes, you will be awarded one of four Superhero Levels at the end of the game.  Developer's note:I have kids that are very into superhero cartoons and games, but when my son was very young, I thought it would be great to have a game that would allow him to fly like a superhero.  However, none of the games I found actually put you into the first person flying position, nor were they easy enough to use at his age.  So, my first idea was to just make a Superhero flight simulator, but he got older during the years it took to produce the game.  So, when my partners suggested that we turn this into an actual arcade type game, I knew it would take much longer and cost more, but I have to agree with them that it was worth every penny and the time it took to bring it all to fruition.  We hope you enjoy it as much as our kids and of course, we ourselves do!

Having a smoothie with Pizza or any other fast food makes a real good combination to enjoy.*****The Story*****Blend the ingredients and start preparing your smoothie with yogurt, candy, fruits, biscuits and various topping items. Kids can play this maker game with ease and simple steps. It’s fun and amazing to cook such delicious and mouth watering smoothie drink without being a chef.*** HOW TO PLAY***• Choose the desired fruit for smoothie• Start blending your smoothie with Yogurt, Ice & Fruit.• Pour your smoothie drink in a glass• Decorate your yummy smoothie with biscuits, candies, icing and more• Your smoothie is ready to drink or share***FEATURES***• Make Yummy and delicious Smoothies.• Various combinations of fruit shakes and colorful toppings• Creativity skills with different colors• Challenge and share your fruity ice shakes with friends through Facebook• Pocket change coins will allow you to get Real Stuff.• Daily bonus to help you unlock items.

games.name: Funi Raccoon Game
games.summary: Stickman! He's at it again. This time he takes his battle to the skies. Following the zombie apocalypse his world has unraveled into more of a fantasy than it was before.Slay evil dragons and other strange phenomena that threaten Stickman as he takes on a chameleon esque super hero role in this fantasy thriller. Play with 4 different Stickman characters including Mega Stick Man and Stick Bot the flying robot dragon.Music and sounds provided in part by freesfx.co.uk. Thanks guys!

games.name: Magical Craft: My Enchanted Dress Shop
games.summary:
The story unfolds in the tranquil village of Frune. The protagonist, a young girl named Lilia, begins her journey as a dressmaker, using the “sewing magic” she inherited from her grandmother.

As she fulfills requests from the villagers and works toward becoming a legendary dressmaker, her everyday life of dressmaking begins.

With a friendly guide and simple controls, even children can enjoy the game with peace of mind.

games.name: Mister Scary - Where Are You?
games.summary: Race across landscapes with the robot as the last hope for humanity. Whether it's apartments, forests, or in the city, all is fair in Robot Racing!---------------------------Features: - Starts with a twist in the screen- Robot- Stars - Coins- Birds of speed - Play in Ipad, Ipod, Iphone, Iphone 5Play now!

games.name: Screaming Halls: Horror
games.summary:
You wake up in a dark hallway with no memory of how you got there. The exit is locked by an ancient curse, and the only way to break it is to find every cursed voodoo doll hidden throughout the endless corridors.

But something else roams the halls.

games.name: Classic Sonic Collection
games.summary: Introducing one of the most addictive "Room Escape" puzzle game for iOSSolve the enigmas and open the door to escape from the collapsing skyscraper.Features:- One of the best door exit game available for iOS- Completely free- Mini escape games which are perfect to kill your free time- Amazing Artwork- Complete utilization of your devices special features!- Addicting mini puzzles!- Realistic graphics and Sound- Balanced difficult level from very easy to very hardHow to play - Solve the puzzle and unlock the current door to get the next level- Each level has a different puzzle to be solved- Use any possible way to unlock: Drag, Shake, Touch the floor, Swipe, Tap,Tilt ,Push Buttons and so on- Many different items availableRemember that in some rooms of the first floors you have to complete the heist in order to open the doors and advance in the game.

games.name: Modern Sonic Collection
games.summary: The Racing Dead Might Just Be The Best Racing Game....EVER!!You HAVE to download it to believe it!....seriously.....download it now....trust me on this one  ;)

games.name: BioMenace Remastered
games.summary: Not just another impossibly hard endless runner! It’s an impossibly hard endless THINKER! In this unique twist on the endless runner genre, you must hit the numbered blocks in order, while frantically dodging the ones you don’t need. Sounds simple, right?You’ve got to have a quick eye (just one will do) and even faster thumbs to stand a chance! Can you keep up?!Are you up to the CHALLENGE?If you can count to seven, and know your colors, you COULD master this game. But be warned, if you DON’T hit your target block in time, you’ll jump forward, and be forced to dodge even FASTER! For the ELITE gamers:Just when you think you’ve got this game figured out, the numbers DISAPPEAR, and you must remember the color order. (Hint: R-O-Y-G-B-I-V) And that’s the least of your worries!Go ahead and give it a try, if you’re fast enough!Features-Easy tap-to-move controls. Left is Down, Right is Up.  Hold the upper portion of the screen to activate your SHIELD!-Incredible original music to get you in the zone!-Gratuitous use of COLORS!-Collect the  to build your shield gauge, but don’t waste it!-The NUMBERS 1 through 7!-Turbo Twitchy Mode (invincibility) when you collect 7 in a row!-Insane speed!-Never play the same level twice!-Your TOP 5 scores SAVED!ProTip: use your shield to bust through any blocks that aren’t your target, but be careful, you don’t want to waste it!Get your adrenaline kick, and get Fast Twitch Color Switch now!Also try "Space Bacon Bulldog", available in the App Store!Like us at facebook.com/kangavarkWe would love to hear your feedback! Drop us a line at kangavark@gmail.com

games.name: Deck of Haunts
games.summary:
Step into the role of a sinister Haunted House, where the walls whisper secrets and terror lurks around every corner. As the master of this cursed domain, your goal is to ensnare daring humans, play on their fears, and drain their very essence to expand your dark influence.

By day, meticulously design the labyrinthine layout of your mansion, transforming it into a death trap that no human can escape. As night falls, lure unwitting explorers into your home, where you'll use a deck of terrifying cards to summon spirits, shift hallways, and unleash spine-chilling horrors. Build tension and drive your guests toward madness, all while protecting your Heart room - the core of your malevolent power.

Once their sanity crumbles, harvest their essence to strengthen your mansion, increasing your infamy and attracting even more daring foes, from law enforcement to priests. But beware, the Stone Masons are coming, ready to challenge your reign of terror...

games.name: Heroic Songs: The Remix
games.summary:
An idol x city-building simulation game where you create your very own fan sanctuary alongside adorable idols to restore the lost connections between worlds!

The adventure begins in a blank, open field beneath the World Tree. From roads to buildings, you’ll place a wide variety of structures to gather resources and grow your city into a thriving sanctuary.

As the Fanctuary develops, you’ll attract more fans, earn Likes, and unlock new concerts. You can even build stages where your idols will perform in front of cheering crowds!

games.name: Neon Abyss 2
games.summary: The latest addictive game on the market! Featuring 15 intense stages as well as an endless mode, you'll never stop playing!STORYDiscover the story of this poor unfortunate soul who lands himself in a strange situation. The only way out is to clean plates! Help him through this and realise how fun cleaning plates can be!ENDLESSJust keep cleaning, and post your score to Facebook or Twitter to show off your cleaning prowess to your friends!

games.name: Once Upon a KATAMARI: Rolling Live Highlights
games.summary: The Rolling LIVE Highlights DLC brings 10 quests and their iconic soundtracks from the mobile game Katamari Damacy Rolling LIVE, where everything revolves around live streaming. Players will roll alongside Earth's streamers, meet new cousins, and grow their Katamari to help the King stay ahead of the trends, impress his fans, and become even more popular.

games.name: Rainbow Islands Console Selection
games.summary:
Rainbow Islands is an arcade action game released by Taito in 1987 where the player controls Bubby or Bobby, using their rainbow magic as both weapons and platforms to climb and reach the goal at the highest point of each stage.

Rainbow Island CS is a collection of several home ports of the arcade game Rainbow Islands.

In addition to the popular 8 and 16-bit versions, the collection includes the never-released-on-cartridge MegaDrive/Genesis version. With 24 quick-save/load slots for each version and a feature that displays the location of the diamonds, there's never been a better time to experience it. It also includes a feature that lets you start the game in a powered-up state.

The PC Engine version is based on the NES version and features a main theme arranged for FM sound by Yukiharu Urita, as well as an ending theme composed by Norihiro Furukawa, both Zuntata (Taito's sound team) alumni.

games.name: Silver Pines
games.summary:
Private investigator Red Walker finds himself in Silver Pines, a place half-abandoned, half-forgotten, in the middle of nowhere on a job to track down Eddie Velvet. A musician who has vanished. As the case begins to reveal a dark past, Walker soon slips into a strange and nightmarish descent beyond his control.

Silver Pines is a survival horror metroidvania set in small town America. Fight nightmarish terrors and solve puzzles, while carefully managing your scarce resources as you uncover the mysteries that could hold the key to redemption.

games.name: Dungeons & Degenerate Gamblers
games.summary: Scavenger Snap is a new twist on the classic scavenger hunt. It is played head to head with 2 players. Player 1 finds an item and SNAPS a photo. They have to do a good job though, because their friend will have to figure out what it is. When Player 2 guesses what the item is correctly, both players get the coins. If they guess wrong, nobody gets coins.Players need to work together to score.  After the puzzle is solved, it is then Player 2's turn to find something and SNAP a photo and send it back to Player 1.The longer the snapping streak goes, the more coins and bonuses are earned.Coins are spent by the finder to get new items or add an arrow.Coins are spent by the guesser for revealing the hint.Coins are earned by the finder and guesser when the puzzle is correctly solved. The coin amount varies based on difficulty.Games can be created with any of your Facebook friends or random players.  Scavenger Snap allows you to have fun and be creative when finding your items, you never know what you will be searching for next.

games.name: HORSE CLUB Ride West
games.summary: The HORSE CLUB is visiting the Wild River Ranch! Travel with your friends Hannah, Sofia, Sarah, and Lisa to the Wild West. Explore the vast landscape, help old and new friends, experience exciting adventures on horseback, and win the crown at the Western riding tournament!

games.name: Sesame Street: Friends & Fun
games.summary:
Welcome to Sesame Street! A place to play, laugh and grow.

From the moment you arrive, there’s so much to do. Join Elmo, Tango and the rest of your Sesame Street friends around the neighborhood!

Walk around with Grover, plant a magical giant beanstalk in Abby’s Garden, find useful tools and rubber ducks in the Community Garden with Bert & Ernie, and work on your number and puzzle skills in Count von Count’s Mansion. Or cook, mix and laugh along with Cookie Monster in his Foodie Truck! Some quests may take a few tries, but you’ll work together to find a way to make the streets a brighter and happier place for everyone.

Make yourself at home! Decorate your house, unlock new mini-games, access exciting new areas of the Street, or throw and unforgettable block party. Spend time with Tango, your cheerful and furry helper or enjoy the whole adventure together with family and friends in local co-op play.

games.name: Colorbound
games.summary:
Bring the world around you to life with the power of color in Colorbound, a vibrant palette-platformer. 

Join Anku on a heartfelt journey to reunite his late grandfather’s band by using color to shape the world around you. As you journey, you’ll solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and help a family of musicians come together one last time.

games.name: Just Dance: Decades of Hits
games.summary:
IMMERSIVE EXPERIENCE SPANNING 6 DECADES
Each decade features its own visual identity and carefully curated tracklist, letting you jump between musical eras or build the ultimate throwback-to-modern playlist in one seamless experience. Discover it all through the all-new Adventure Mode, a cheerful story-driven journey that has you dancing your way through the decades.

DANCE TO SONGS EVERYONE KNOWS
Celebrate iconic intergenerational hits brought to life with unique choreography, including fan-favorites like:

- "NUEVAYoL" by Bad Bunny
- "Manchild" by Sabrina Carpenter
- "Danza Kuduro" by Lucenzo & Don Omar
- "Turn Down for What" by DJ Snake & Lil Jon
- "Feel Good Inc." by Gorillaz
- "Bye Bye Bye" by *NSYNC
- "Wannabe" by Spice Girls
- "No Scrubs" by TLC
- "It's Tricky" by Run DMC
- "Uptown Girl" by Billy Joel
- "Mamma Mia" by ABBA

games.name: SpongeBob SquarePants: Titans of the Tide
games.summary: Prepare to be scared! A clash between the Flying Dutchman and King Neptune has unleashed ghostly mayhem all over Bikini Bottom. Switch seamlessly between SpongeBob and Patrick, combine their unique skills and save Bikini Bottom from total ghostification!

games.name: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse
games.summary:
1499. Paris is engulfed as monstrous creatures suddenly emerge from the shadows.

Armed with the legendary holy whip, the Vampire Killer, Trevor Belmont’s successor ventures into the burning streets and the looming castle to hunt down the beasts.

Will she succeed in saving Paris from devastation...?

Set 23 years after Castlevania Dracula's Curse - follow a young Belmont's journey in an all new 2D Action-Exploration title from KONAMI, Evil Empire and Motion Twin.

games.name: SHOCKWAVE TRIGGERS
games.summary: -Candy Jump is an endless jump game that you will enjoy for hours.-Choose from five cute characters!-Avoid enemies and pick up power ups to complete the journey-Compete with your friends by inviting them via Facebook

games.name: Bluey's Happy Snaps
games.summary:
Explore, have fun and capture your favorite moments with Bluey and Bingo in this photo-powered game. Look out for familiar spots from the show, create your own scrapbook and turn in-game memories into playful moments for real life.

Bluey and Bingo have found Dad's old camera (back from when he was cool). Take it with you around the world of Bluey and snap photos of the games they play and wildlife they discover. Each snapshot is saved to Bluey's scrapbook, where players can keep their favorite moments.

Share the adventure side-by-side! A second player can join in to explore and strike a pose while the main player leads the adventure behind the camera. You can even play with toys together along the way!

games.name: Disney/Pixar Toy Story 3 Complete Edition
games.summary:
Reopen the toy chest and saddle up as Woody, Buzz Lightyear, and Jessie in Toy Story 3 Complete Edition, a 3D adventure based on the hit 2010 animated film, Toy Story 3. The updated game features improved graphics and a few new surprises in store. Play through authentic moments from the movie in Story Mode, or drop into the wild west sandbox of Woody’s Roundup in Toy Box Mode.

In Story Mode, swap between Woody, Buzz, and Jessie as you play through iconic scenes from the film, including the train rescue, Operation Playtime, surviving the junkyard, and more. Harness each character's unique abilities, whether you need to swing on Woody’s pull string or use Buzz’s strength to throw the other toys long distances. You can even play in two-player co-op.

Step out of Story Mode and into the sandbox in Toy Box Mode. This fan-favorite, customizable mode drops you into the wild west of Woody’s Roundup. Like Story Mode, you play as Woody, Buzz, or Jessie, but in Toy Box Mode you can play however you want! Characters around town give you quests to complete, so you can earn gold and spend it on personalizing the town your way. Build, decorate and customize the buildings, dress up the townsfolk, and more.

games.name: Disney/Pixar Toy Story: Retro Roundup!
games.summary:
Step back into Andy’s room with Woody, Buzz Lightyear, and more classic characters in Toy Story: Retro Roundup!

This five-game collection features console and handheld versions of four early Toy Story titles, as well as A Bug’s Life. All the games have been upgraded with new features, quality-of-life improvements, and an overflowing toy chest of behind-the-scenes content. 

Revisit the ‘90s and early 2000s hits you loved and share these titles with a new generation of Toy Story fans.

games.name: Harvest Moon: Echoes of Teradea
games.summary:
The mist of the Forest of Echoes now covers the land of Teradea, and outside of Bloomfield Village where you were raised, wild wolves appear at night. There are even rumors of a large guardian wolf that rules them all...but you and your best friend are about to change that!

Throwing caution to the wind, you’ll set out on a mission to tame those wolves and end up unlocking a journey far greater than you imagined. Help the Guardian Spirits to revive and revitalize Teradea! Visit the port village of Tidewind to uncover what’s causing the storms there. Trek to the mining village of Quarrytop to get to the bottom of the mystery of the earthquakes that are happening. Then, stay in the once-thriving town and cultural center of Maplehill to revive its fading light and community.

Between your travels, tend your farm, raise animals, harvest crops, and build a life for yourself. Guided by the Harvest Goddess and aided by the friends you’ll make in each of the villages, you’ll find new ways to grow, explore, and lend a hand wherever it’s needed. 

With the support of those you’ve helped - and those who stand beside you - you may discover a way to lift the veil from the Forest of Echoes and let Teradea flourish once more!

games.name: Tavern Talk: Complete Edition
games.summary:
Discover the cozy fantasy world of Tavern Talk Complete Edition, the first-ever physical Nintendo Switch release of the beloved visual novel adventure.

This Deluxe Edition includes the full base game along with both the Pirate Palooza and Tempest Tantrum DLC on cartridge, delivering the complete Wayfarer’s Inn experience in one definitive package.

games.name: The Jackbox Party Pack 12
games.summary:
The idea wizards at Jackbox Games are following up on the hit Party Pack 11 with brand-new party games!

The Jackbox Party Pack 12 will include 5 different games designed to take your party to new heights. You’ll find new ways to channel your inner comedian, artist, mind reader, debater, and team captain. Like the true multihyphenate you are! Are you sure you didn’t time-travel from the Renaissance era?  

In true Party Pack fashion, no extra controllers are necessary! Use your smartphones, tablets, or computer browsers to join the game and play along. Got a big group? Additional players can jump into audience mode to influence the game in unique ways.

games.name: Toy Story: Retro Roundup! / Toy Story 3: Complete Edition
games.summary:
Get all the toys in the toy chest with this double pack, featuring both Toy Story: Retro Roundup! and Toy Story 3 Complete Edition. Play as classic characters as you navigate familiar worlds and take on challenges inspired by the films. 

Toy Story: Retro Roundup! includes 11 classic games, with both console and handheld versions of four Toy Story games, along with A Bug’s Life. 

Toy Story 3 Complete Edition brings back the fan-favorite 3D adventure for modern consoles!

games.name: Tales of Eternia Remastered
games.summary:
Journey to Eternia, a world split into two isolated realms, Inferia and Celestia.

In the remote Inferian village of Rasheans, Reid Hershel and his childhood friend Farah Oersted meet a mysterious girl named Meredy. During their journey to discover Meredy's origins, the group discovers that a collision called the "Great Fall" threatens both Inferia and Celesita.

Harnessing the power of elemental spirits known as the Greater Craymels, Reid and his companions embark on an epic journey to save the two realms from catastrophe.

games.name: Tenebris Somnia
games.summary:
Tenebris Somnia is a survival horror adventure game in the same vein as classics like Silent Hill or Resident Evil - but adapted to a retro 2D aesthetic from the 8 or 16-bit era.

You will struggle to survive while solving puzzles and fighting horrible creatures. 

Yet the secrets of the game lie within its cinematics...

When you reach certain key points you will see sequences from a completely different point of view, made in live action with real actors and practical effects - created by a professional and award winning film crew from Argentina.

games.name: I Am Your Beast
games.summary: Test your reflexes with this quick paced reflex game!Tap the blue circles for points!Tap the green circles to add to your time!Tap the red circles and lose time!~Upcoming updates~More sounds.More animations.More game modes.Multiplayer!Much More!

games.name: Cotton Reboot! High Tension!
games.summary:
The sequel to "Cotton Reboot!" released in 2021 is here! Will the gluttonous witch Nata de Cotton be in action again this time?

Enjoy this even more powerful and refreshing witchy shooter!

games.name: Demons' Night Fever
games.summary:
Based on classic grid-based strategy games, this entirely new SRPG features the Peon Exploitation System - a brutal combat mechanic where you mercilessly sacrifice your own allies.

The more misdeeds you commit, the more vicious your army becomes, and the greater your advantage in battle!

Regain the lost power of the Devil, Giga Super Death, who was transformed into a baby, and crush the false god wearing a mask of justice!

games.name: Final Fantasy Resonance
games.summary: Return to the pixel‑art world of FINAL FANTASY, evolved from its classic roots. Travel with companions bound by fate and call on Visions to aid you in battle to uncover the truth behind a force that threatens to bring everything to ruin.

games.name: ONE PIECE: Grand Gourmet
games.summary: Hop aboard a delectable management sim in the world of ONE PIECE! Work alongside the Straw Hat Crew to build the greatest floating restaurant of the seas. Collect ingredients, dream up dishes, and decorate to have familiar faces lining up for more!

games.name: Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest
games.summary: Create your own Warrior Cat and journey through the Lake Territories in an immersive action-adventure inspired by the beloved Warrior Cats book series. Hunt, explore, battle rival Clans, uncover prophecies, and shape your legacy with every choice you make.

games.name: 9 R.I.P. sequel
games.summary:
The previous work, "9 RIP," weaves the story of a bizarre love and the supernatural encounters in the afterlife. In this "9 RIP sequel," you can enjoy the continuation of the story.

The work begins with the two endings from the previous work. The main content, "Heaven Edition," which takes place after "Final Act: Heaven," is a sequel that depicts a new horror.

The sub-content, "God Edition," which takes place after "Final Act: God," is a fan disc that leads to a sweet and happy ending.

Please look forward to the various strange worlds and the fate of the strange characters and the love that is woven once again.

games.name: Dog Man: Bark in Action
games.summary:
Join Dog Man and his Supa Buddies for a supa-new adventure! A comic-book style game packed with action, humor, boss fights, and ability-granting gadgets. Play as 10 different characters from the comics, each with unique powers.

A hero is needed! Dr. Scum has set up Hypno Screens around the city, mind-controlling the innocent townsfolk. Now it’s up to Dog Man - part Dog, part Man- to fight back against Dr. Scum and all his minions. Defeat Dr. Scum, save your friends, and rescue the city!

games.name: Village in the Shade
games.summary:
From the development team behind the Yomawari series, Hono Gurashi no Niwa is a life simulation game set in a nostalgic rural village.

Farm and take care of livestock, enjoy activities like fishing and hunting, and deepen your relationships with the other villagers…

Your nostalgic and heartwarming rural life begins.

games.name: Gennady
games.summary: Gennady is a dynamic roguelike platformer, where you must fight your way through shifting corridors filled with chthonic creatures, and death only makes you stronger. All wrapped in the legendary absurdity and classic animation inspired by the era of Earthworm Jim.

games.name: Hello Kitty Party Land
games.summary: Join the party at Party Land and team up with beloved Sanrio characters to play together in a variety of exciting mini games. Meet over 145 beloved characters and collect their stickers! Team up with one of 16 playable Sanrio characters and play as your own avatar or your favorite teammate. Jump into 45+ mini games with friends, either offline or online. Try Board Game mode, and keep the fun going with quick mini games while you wait for your turn.  Create a character that’s uniquely yours! Customize everything from hairstyles to outfits, and unlock even more items as you progress through the game.

games.name: The Wolf Among Us Remastered
games.summary:
Step back into Fabletown in The Wolf Among Us Remastered - the definitive edition of Telltale’s acclaimed noir narrative thriller inspired by DC’s award-winning Fables comic series.

Critically acclaimed, The Wolf Among Us became one of the most celebrated story-driven adventures of its generation, praised for its unforgettable characters, sharp writing, and meaningful player choice.

Fully remastered with enhanced visuals and modern presentation, this definitive edition brings Bigby Wolf’s first investigation to life with greater atmosphere, immersion, and detail than ever before - honoring the original experience while introducing Fabletown to a new generation of players.

Investigate brutal murders, interrogate suspects, explore crime scenes, and uncover a conspiracy hiding beneath the streets of Fabletown, where myths and legends live secretly among us.
